lyrics_set.lyrics:
[Intro]
[Verse]
Dusty roads stretch beneath the morning light
The coffee in the mug is steaming bright
A weathered fence line marks the valley floor
I find the peace I was looking for
[Pre-Chorus]
The wind hums low like a distant choir
Setting every heavy thought on fire
[Chorus]
Oh, the land is wide and the sky is deep
Secrets in the soil that the mountains keep
Every mile is a story left to tell
Under the magic of the evening spell
[Verse]
Old pines whisper secrets in the pines
Tracing out the maps of ancient lines
A rusted gate swings on a steady hinge
Where the golden fields and the meadows fringe
[Pre-Chorus]
The sun bows down in a steady glow
Following the paths where the wild seeds grow
[Chorus]
Oh, the land is wide and the sky is deep
Secrets in the soil that the mountains keep
Every mile is a story left to tell
Under the magic of the evening spell
[Instrumental]
[Bridge]
The shadows stretch and the colors fade
In the quiet light that the twilight made
[Chorus]
Oh, the land is wide and the sky is deep
Secrets in the soil that the mountains keep
Every mile is a story left to tell
Under the magic of the evening spell
[Outro]
